description: This file defines the EndpointProvider class in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods to resolve endpoints, create default providers, and pattern-based providers for AWS services.

classes.name: EndpointProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to resolve AWS service endpoints, create default providers, and pattern-based providers.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns an endpoint from a provider, throws exception if unable.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns the default endpoint provider, deprecated in favor of Partition.

methods.name: patterns
methods.description: Creates an endpoint provider using specified patterns.
